task.prompt:
We have a PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL stored procedure whose current implementation is attached as current_procedure.sql. It is functionally correct and defines the required behaviour. On real data volumes it runs too slowly.

When a performance row has Attendance less than para_Attendance, the procedure sets its "integer" column to 'staging'.

Please rewrite the attached procedure so that it does exactly the same thing with less database work. For every input, the final database state must be identical to what the attached procedure produces.

The procedure must keep exactly this signature and parameter list:
sp(para_Num_of_Pieces integer, para_Performance_ID integer, para_Attendance integer, para_integer text)

Return only the complete stored procedure and nothing else.

Also, the prose says the procedure sets performance."integer" to 'staging' when Attendance < para_Attendance, but the shown code sets it to para_Performance_ID::text (var2) — is 'staging' a literal used somewhere, and which behavior is authoritative?

The procedure assigns var2 to the "integer" column in that branch; 'staging' is not used.

args.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp_orig(para_Num_of_Pieces integer, para_Performance_ID integer, para_Attendance integer, para_integer text) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR SELECT "Attendance", "integer" FROM pA WHERE "Attendance" > para_Attendance; rec RECORD; att RECORD; var1 integer; var2 text; v_attendance integer; v_integer text; BEGIN var1 := para_Num_of_Pieces * 2; var2 := para_Performance_ID::text; IF para_Num_of_Pieces < 10 THEN FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Num_of_Pieces" FROM mA LOOP IF rec."Num_of_Pieces" < var1 THEN UPDATE mA SET "Num_of_Pieces" = "Num_of_Pieces" + para_Performance_ID WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Attendance", "integer" FROM pA LOOP IF rec."Attendance" = para_Attendance AND rec."integer" LIKE var2 THEN DELETE FROM pA WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Attendance" FROM pA LOOP IF rec."Attendance" = para_Attendance THEN UPDATE pA SET "Location" = CONCAT("Location", ':', var2) WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Attendance" FROM pA LOOP IF rec."Attendance" >= var1 THEN UPDATE pA SET "Host" = CONCAT("Host", ':', var2) WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; ELSIF para_Num_of_Pieces < 20 THEN OPEN cur; LOOP FETCH cur INTO rec; EXIT WHEN NOT FOUND; v_attendance := rec."Attendance"; v_integer := rec."integer"; FOR att IN SELECT ctid AS row_id FROM mA WHERE "Num_of_Pieces" = v_attendance LOOP UPDATE mA SET "Performance_ID" = v_integer WHERE ctid = att.row_id; END LOOP; var1 := var1 + 1; END LOOP; CLOSE cur; ELSIF para_Num_of_Pieces < 30 THEN FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Attendance" FROM pA LOOP IF rec."Attendance" < para_Attendance THEN UPDATE pA SET "integer" = var2 WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id FROM mA LOOP UPDATE mA SET "Performance_ID" = CONCAT("Performance_ID", '_updated') WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END LOOP; FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Attendance" FROM pA LOOP IF rec."Attendance" % 5 = 0 THEN DELETE FROM pA WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; ELSIF para_Num_of_Pieces < 40 THEN FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id FROM mA LOOP IF para_Performance_ID > 50 THEN UPDATE mA SET "Num_of_Pieces" = "Num_of_Pieces" / 2 WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; ELSE UPDATE mA SET "Num_of_Pieces" = "Num_of_Pieces" * 3 WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "integer" FROM pA LOOP IF rec."integer" IS NULL THEN DELETE FROM pA WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; INSERT INTO pA ("Attendance", "integer") VALUES (var1, 'fallback'); ELSE INSERT INTO pA ("Attendance", "integer") VALUES (para_Attendance, para_integer); FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Num_of_Pieces" FROM mA LOOP IF rec."Num_of_Pieces" > 100 THEN UPDATE mA SET "Performance_ID" = 'final_state' WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; END IF; END; $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp_new(para_Num_of_Pieces integer, para_Performance_ID integer, para_Attendance integer, para_integer text) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE var1 integer; var2 text; BEGIN var1 := para_Num_of_Pieces * 2; var2 := para_Performance_ID::text; IF para_Num_of_Pieces < 10 THEN UPDATE mB SET "Num_of_Pieces" = "Num_of_Pieces" + para_Performance_ID WHERE "Num_of_Pieces" < var1; DELETE FROM pB WHERE "Attendance" = para_Attendance AND "integer" LIKE var2; UPDATE pB SET "Location" = CONCAT("Location", ':', var2) WHERE "Attendance" = para_Attendance; UPDATE pB SET "Host" = CONCAT("Host", ':', var2) WHERE "Attendance" >= var1; ELSIF para_Num_of_Pieces < 20 THEN UPDATE mB ma SET "Performance_ID" = p."integer" FROM pB p WHERE p."Attendance" > para_Attendance AND ma."Num_of_Pieces" = p."Attendance"; ELSIF para_Num_of_Pieces < 30 THEN UPDATE pB SET "integer" = var2 WHERE "Attendance" < para_Attendance; UPDATE mB SET "Performance_ID" = CONCAT("Performance_ID", '_updated'); DELETE FROM pB WHERE "Attendance" % 5 = 0; ELSIF para_Num_of_Pieces < 40 THEN UPDATE mB SET "Num_of_Pieces" = CASE WHEN para_Performance_ID > 50 THEN "Num_of_Pieces" / 2 ELSE "Num_of_Pieces" * 3 END; DELETE FROM pB WHERE "integer" IS NULL; INSERT INTO pB ("Attendance", "integer") VALUES (var1, 'fallback'); ELSE INSERT INTO pB ("Attendance", "integer") VALUES (para_Attendance, para_integer); UPDATE mB SET "Performance_ID" = 'final_state' WHERE "Num_of_Pieces" > 100; END IF; END; $$;
